# Mathematical Discourse

> A peer-reviewed video journal for mathematical research talks.

Mathematical Discourse publishes curated video talks by leading mathematicians, organized by issue and volume. Each talk includes a video recording, abstract, table of contents with timestamps, and citation information.

## Content

- Talks: Video recordings of mathematical research presentations
- Issues: Grouped collections of talks published periodically
- Subject Areas: Algebra, Algebraic Geometry, Analysis, Combinatorics, Dynamics, Geometry, Lie Theory, Logic, Number Theory, Partial Differential Equations, Probability, Topology

## Structure

- /: Homepage with the current issue
- /issues: All issues listed by volume
- /issue/[slug]: Individual issue with its talks
- /issue/[slug]/[talk]: Individual talk page with video, abstract, synopsis, and table of contents
- /about: About the journal and editorial board
- /submit: Submission guidelines
- /search: Search and filter all talks by subject, format, issue, and year
- /subject/[slug]: Talks filtered by mathematical subject area

## Contact

Mathematical Discourse is published by the Institute for Advanced Study.
